name: API Orchestrator - ECA Integration
description: ECA (Events, Conditions, Actions) integration: trigger API Orchestrator requests from no-code workflows and branch on API responses.
project_description: API Orchestrator - ECA Integration connects API Orchestrator to the ECA module. It provides ECA actions to send a pre-configured endpoint request (queued or direct) and to make a direct HTTP request via an API service, ECA conditions to test the last response (contains text, status code, service exists), and ECA events derived from API Orchestrator request completion/failure. This enables no-code workflows that call external APIs and react to their responses. Requires api_orchestrator and eca. Lifecycle: stable. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
